# Book Cover Maker

Book cover maker: covers for novels, ebooks and self-published KDP books, generated with your title and author name spelled out.

## What it does
Give the title, the author, the genre and the imagery. Claude tells you the price and creates a front cover in portrait.

**How the files are made:** each book cover is generated by an image model that MegaScenes runs through its model providers. Nothing is made until you say yes, and the price in credits comes first.

Front cover image only; spine and back cover are not included.

## Install
In Claude Code:
```
/plugin marketplace add megascenes-app/claude-plugins
/plugin install book-cover-maker@megascenes
```

## Connecting
- Book Cover Maker talks to the MegaScenes server at `https://megascenes.com/api/claude/book-cover/mcp` (Streamable HTTP).
- Connecting opens MegaScenes: sign in, create an account, or continue without one and add your email when you pay (OAuth with PKCE). Then you come straight back to the chat.
- Each book cover uses credits from your MegaScenes account and is priced before it runs; new accounts can start with a low-cost trial week.
- The book covers show in a viewer in the chat where Claude supports interactive apps; in Claude Code you get the links.

## Tools
| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `list_book_cover_models` | Models for book covers with settings and starting prices. Read-only. |
| `estimate_book_cover_cost` | Exact price of one book cover before it runs. Read-only. |
| `create_book_cover` | Starts one book cover in your account. Uses credits; needs sign-in. |
| `get_book_cover` | Status and file links. Read-only. |
| `get_account` | Your plan and credit balance. Read-only. |

## Example prompts
- "A thriller cover for 'The Silent Harbor' by J. Moreau"
- "A fantasy cover with a dragon over a castle, title 'Emberfall'"
- "A clean self-help cover for 'Small Wins Daily'"

## Data and privacy
What you give for the book cover (the title, the author, the genre and the imagery) goes to MegaScenes, stays in your MegaScenes account with the finished file, and is passed to the model provider that makes it. The plugin has no hooks or local scripts and sends nothing else.
